findings.title: Catalog trust discarded

findings.title: Initial paused/unresolved queries claim empty archive
findings.mechanism: firstLoad uses isLoading rather than unresolved state.hasData/status. Initial pending+paused has isLoading=false, rows=[] and stats.total=0, so :112 renders No archived notifications yet. StaleRefreshWarning :60 returns null without data. InboxBody :258 similarly gates initialLoading by isLoading and :814-830 chooses archive-empty without a successful payload.

repro.condition: Synthetic snapshot data=undefined,status=pending,fetchStatus=paused,isLoading=false,error=null; summary and list choose authoritative-empty copy rather than unresolved/paused evidence.

findings.fix: Use existing trust state to distinguish unresolved initial/paused from successful []; keep shells and blocked-refresh explanation, never invent zero or a server error.
findings.test_source_limit: Summary test :201 covers paused WITH rows only; :233 explicitly expects undefined idle query as empty. No initial-paused archive assertion in the five fully read suites.

findings.title: Count failure removes pagination without count-local recovery
findings.mechanism: Count fatalError is text-only; paginationControls :784-791 exists only with countData. PullToRefresh :716 and list Retry :808 refetch only logs, not count. Without retained count, StaleRefreshWarning has no retry.

repro.condition: Synthetic rows GET succeeds with50 rows; count_only fails after automatic retries. Total becomes unavailable, pagination disappears, list refresh does not explicitly refetch count.

findings.fix: Add countQuery.refetch via existing source-local retry feedback; retain loaded rows/unknown total, no fabricated denominator.
findings.test_source_limit: InboxBody.test.tsx:596 asserts unknown total after failure, not count retry/pagination recovery.

repro.condition: Synthetic vehicle_id=1,2&rule_id=10,20 with catalogs: both arrays reach rows/count but chips/selects show Model1/Rule10 without second value/cardinality.

findings.fix: Accurately show all IDs or N-selected and retain multi-ID/removal semantics through existing controls; never silently drop additional URL scope.
